title: VRAM reserve 1280 -> 896 MiB (alternative to C3a; do not combine at first)
inspiration: Free expert-cache slots: vram_free_mib = 0 at baseline; expert cache ~20.3 GiB.
conditions: WARNING: on this box the reserve absorbs other local GPU consumers (vision encoder process, image/video generation peaks via the shared-GPU profile). Verify with nvidia-smi DURING a heavy non-inference job before committing to a smaller reserve.
acceptance: expert_slots increases beyond baseline AND hit_rate >= 0.96, with zero OOM/crash while the other local GPU workloads run.
verdict: NOT ATTEMPTED (2026-10-30): deliberately shelved - the freed margin belongs to workloads that are not inference, and the KV saving from C3a already showed slots may not be the binding term here.
